blockbuilder-explorer.visual_critic_note: Intentional dark theme with consistent muted palette and organized grid layout shows design thinking, but the Color Usage scatter panel devolves into an unreadable noise field at this size, and the force-directed graph labels overlap badly — two of the four views fail the 'can a viewer extract the data' test.
blockbuilder-explorer.encoding_integrity_note: Honest throughout: bar chart has zero baseline, both node and color-dot size use scaleSqrt for correct area encoding, all dynamic domains use d3.extent/d3.max, and monthly histogram bins are data-driven; hardcoded HCL axes (hue 0–360, lightness 0–100) are semantically bounded, not arbitrary.
blockbuilder-explorer.cognitive_load_note: 4-panel layout stays within working memory limits, the dark theme visually unifies views, and the network (60 nodes) shows legible clustering — the main drag is the color-usage scatter which reads as dense noise without interaction to pull a specific color into focus.
